name: Folklore
original_name: f o l k l o r e
source:
Earl is a simple guy whose life consists of working in the rice fields. One day, a mysterious girl appears. The girl knows what Earl really wants, and teaches him the art of fighting. He decides to live by the sword from now on, and visits disaster on his village.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031935.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
厄尔是一个简单的人，他的生活就是在稻田里干活。有一天，一位神秘的女孩出现了。女孩知道厄尔真正想要什么，并教他战斗的艺术。他决定从此以后靠剑为生，并给他的村庄带来了灾难。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031935.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
